test_ArrayView_init_and_buffer: test the corrade containers ArrayView and MutableArrayView classes for initialization with bytes and bytearray buffers
test_StridedArrayView_slicing_and_ops: test the corrade containers StridedArrayView1D through StridedArrayView4D classes for slicing, flipping, broadcasting, transposing, and expanding operations
test_BitArray_and_BitArrayView: test the corrade containers BitArray and BitArrayView classes for bit-level initialization, mutable access, and slicing with stride support
test_StridedBitArrayView_multidimensiona: test the corrade containers StridedBitArrayView1D through StridedBitArrayView4D classes for multidimensional bit array slicing, transposing, and expanding
test_Optional_type_bindings: test the corrade containers Optional type bindings for simple and nested optional value acquisition and retrieval
